lines.en: label day304:
scene hallnoonwinter
I make my way down the hall after the final bell rings.
lines.zh: 终响铃敲响之后，我沿着走廊往外走。

lines.en: A certain rich girl (The one who doesn’t want to have my children) has been glaring at me for the entire day, so I’m trying to escape as quickly as I-
lines.zh: 某个有钱人家的大小姐（那个不想替我生孩子的）一整天都在瞪我，所以我在设法尽快逃——

lines.en: : Get back here right now!
lines.zh: : 现在就给我回来！

lines.en: Like I said, I’m trying to escape as quickly as I-
lines.zh: 就像我说的，我在设法尽快逃——

lines.en: : Sensei! I’m warning you!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我在警告你！

lines.en: : If you do not turn around and hear what I have to say, I will be filing a complaint with the board of education!
lines.zh: : 如果你不转过身来听我要说的话，我就要向教育委员会投诉了！

lines.en: I quicken my pace only to be met by the sound of Touka’s shoes rapidly clopping against the floor seconds later.
lines.zh: 我加快了脚步，几秒钟后，迎接我的却是 Touka 的鞋子在地板上急促的哒哒声。

lines.en: If this is the last time you ever hear from me, I just want you to know that I’ve had fun.
lines.zh: 如果这是你最后一次听到我的消息，我只想让你知道，我过得挺开心的。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasutoukahall1
: Finally! I was beginning to think you were going to walk all the way home!
lines.zh: : 总算！我还以为你要一路走回家去呢！

lines.en: : That was the plan.
lines.zh: : 那本来就是计划。

lines.en: : You should show more concern when your students are in clear distress.
lines.zh: : 你的学生明显处于痛苦之中，你应该表现出更多的关心。

lines.en: : You’re right. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。抱歉。

lines.en: : Yasu, are you okay? Touka seems to have quite the grip on your collar.
lines.zh: : Yasu，你还好吗？Touka 揪你衣领揪得挺紧的。

lines.en: : It’s...a little hard to breathe...but I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 有点……喘不上气……不过我没事。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall2
: I meant concern for me! I am clearly in greater distress than my new {i}roommate{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我是说关心我！明明我比我的新{i}室友{/i}痛苦多了。

lines.en: : Honestly, you seem to be the one leading the charge here.
lines.zh: : 说实话，看起来带头冲锋的那个人是你。

lines.en: : I barely slept at all last night with her incessant rambling!
lines.zh: : 她一整晚喋喋不休，我几乎一夜都没睡！

lines.en: : I take it the move went well, then?
lines.zh: : 看来搬家进行得很顺利咯？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall3
: No! It was one of the worst nights of my life!
lines.zh: : 不！那是我这辈子最糟糕的几个夜晚之一！

lines.en: : How do I return her? Do you still have the receipt?
lines.zh: : 我该怎么把她退掉？你还留着收据吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}buy{/i} her, Touka. And most human traffickers don’t accept returns.
lines.zh: : 她又不是我{i}买{/i}来的，Touka。而且大多数人贩子也不接受退货。

lines.en: : I know this because I have a good amount of experience as a human trafficker myself.
lines.zh: : 我之所以知道这个，是因为我自己当人贩子的经验相当丰富。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall4
: This is no time for fun and games, Sensei. This demon is clearly out to get me.
lines.zh: : 现在不是开玩笑的时候，Sensei。这个恶魔显然是冲着我来的。

lines.en: : Is she? Because she looks pretty harmless right now. Especially with you being able to drag her around the hall.
lines.zh: : 是吗？可她现在看起来相当无害。尤其是你还能拽着她在走廊里到处走。

lines.en: : Touka is right when she says that I kept her up very late, but it was not my intention to do that.
lines.zh: : Touka 说我把她弄到很晚才睡，这点她说得没错，但那不是我的本意。

lines.en: : I have to pray for at least four hours every night before I’m able to close my eyes. And I did not want to pray in the hall.
lines.zh: : 我每天晚上至少要祈祷四个小时，才能闭上眼睛。而我又不想在外面走廊里祈祷。

lines.en: : Well, can you promise to...pray quieter next time or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，你能不能保证下次……祈祷得小声一点，之类的？

lines.en: : I can promise to try.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证试试。

lines.en: : Great. Problem solved then.
lines.zh: : 很好。那问题就解决了。

lines.en: scene hallnoonwinter
I turn away from the newest members of my class and-
lines.zh: 我转身背对班上最新来的这两位，然后——

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall1
: No you don’t! We are nowhere near finished!
lines.zh: : 你想得美！我们离结束还差得远呢！

lines.en: : I am not leaving this building until you assure me that I will be trading Yasu for another girl!
lines.zh: : 在你向我保证会把 Yasu 换成另一个女孩之前，我不会离开这栋楼！

lines.en: : I would honestly even take the mean looking one at this point! At least she probably doesn’t “pray” for four hours every night!
lines.zh: : 说真的，到这个地步我甚至愿意换那个看起来很凶的！至少她大概不会每天晚上“祈祷”四个小时！

lines.en: : Hey, for all you know, Yumi could be even more religious than Yasu is.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说不定 Yumi 比 Yasu 还要更虔诚呢，你又不知道。

lines.en: : All I want is to be friends, Touka...I’m sorry if I upset you.
lines.zh: : 我只想交个朋友，Touka……如果我惹你不高兴了，我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall5
: You don’t understand the first thing about friends, Yasu! Friends let each other {i}sleep!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你对朋友一无所知，Yasu！朋友是让彼此{i}睡觉{/i}的！

lines.en: : To be fair, you don’t really understand the first thing about friends either, Touka.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你对朋友其实也一无所知，Touka。

lines.en: : You and Yasu probably just need to bond.
lines.zh: : 你和 Yasu 大概只是需要培养一下感情。

lines.en: : Sensei is right. If we are going to be successful roommates, we should first learn to deal with each other’s flaws.
lines.zh: : Sensei 说得对。如果我们要成为合得来的室友，首先应该学会容忍彼此的缺点。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall6
: Hmph! Luckily for you, I don’t have any flaws. So your job should be quite easy.
lines.zh: : 哼！算你走运，我没有任何缺点。所以你的工作应该相当轻松。

lines.en: : That’s right, Touka. You’re the perfect, ideal woman and I am but a worm wriggling desperately on the ground beneath you, praying to not be stepped on.
lines.zh: : 没错，Touka。你是完美的理想女性，而我不过是一条在你脚下的地面上绝望扭动的虫子，祈祷着不要被踩到。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall7
: Wait...There’s no need to be that harsh on yourself.
lines.zh: : 等等……没必要把自己说得那么难听。

lines.en: : Weren’t you calling her a demon like, one minute ago?
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前不是还在叫她恶魔吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but that’s before she began self-deprecating.
lines.zh: : 是的，但那是在她开始自我贬低之前。

lines.en: : Mother told me that I can not be putting myself above others, and having Yasu refer to herself as a worm beneath my feet makes me feel as if I may have failed.
lines.zh: : 母亲告诉过我，我不能把自己置于他人之上，而让 Yasu 把自己说成我脚下的虫子，让我觉得自己也许是失败了。

lines.en: : I am not even worthy of the bacteria crawling off of your fingertips onto the collar of my shirt.
lines.zh: : 我连从你指尖爬到我衬衫衣领上的细菌都不配。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall8
: There is no bacteria on my fingertips! I wash my hands after every single thing I do! The way a proper lady should!
lines.zh: : 我的指尖上根本没有什么细菌！我每做一件事之后都会洗手！一位得体的淑女就该这样！

lines.en: : Do proper ladies also scream at the top of their lungs in the hallway?
lines.zh: : 得体的淑女还会在走廊里扯着嗓子尖叫吗？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall9
: Well...no. But I-
lines.zh: : 嗯……不会。但我——

lines.en: : It’s okay, Touka...Even if you cast me out into the hall for my nightly prayer, I won’t think any less of you.
lines.zh: : 没关系的，Touka……就算你为了我每晚的祈祷而把我赶到走廊上去，我也不会因此看轻你。

lines.en: : I do want the two of us to get along. So if exiling me is what you believe must be done for that to happen, I shall gather what little belongings I have and flee forever.
lines.zh: : 我确实希望我们两个能好好相处。所以如果你认为必须把我放逐才能做到，那我就收拾好我那点可怜的随身物品，永远消失。

lines.en: : How exactly would exiling yourself help you two get along?
lines.zh: : 把自己放逐出去，到底怎么能帮你们两个好好相处？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall10
: Our physical forms are not the only way our thoughts can connect with one another.
lines.zh: : 我们的肉体，并不是思想彼此相连的唯一途径。

lines.en: : If Touka and I close our eyes at the exact same time and utter the third verse of [[redacted], our thoughts will connect and our minds will become one until the sun next rises.
lines.zh: : 如果 Touka 和我在完全相同的时刻闭上眼睛，念出《[[redacted]》的第三节，我们的思想就会相连，我们的心智将合二为一，直到太阳再次升起。

lines.en: : Yasu, this is precisely why I do not think it is possible for us to get along.
lines.zh: : Yasu，这正是我认为我们不可能合得来的原因。

lines.en: : I don’t understand the first thing about your...religion. And I fear that even attempting to do so would lead to me becoming even more of an outcast than I already am.
lines.zh: : 我对你的……宗教一无所知。而且我害怕，就连尝试去了解，都会让我变得比现在更加被排斥。

lines.en: : Did she tell you the thing about dying animals yet?
lines.zh: : 她跟你说了垂死的动物那件事了吗？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall11
: No! And I do not want her to!
lines.zh: : 没有！而且我也不想听！

lines.en: : You remember!
lines.zh: : 你记得！

lines.en: : Yeah. I have a hard time forgetting things that scary girls yell at me in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 嗯。可怕的女孩半夜冲我吼的话，我很难忘掉。

lines.en: : I am not scary, Sensei. What is scary is the thought of living in perpetual misery and fear, far off in the looming darkness and covered in wires.
lines.zh: : 我不可怕，Sensei。可怕的是永远活在痛苦与恐惧中的念头——在逼近的黑暗深处，浑身缠满电线。

lines.en: : These are the things that are scary. These are the things I can protect you from.
lines.zh: : 这些才是可怕的东西。这些才是我能保护你远离的东西。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall12
: And yet you continue to stray. How sad.
lines.zh: : 可你却继续偏离。多么可悲。

lines.en: : How on earth do you keep switching from smiling to crying so quickly? It’s immensely unsettling.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么做到在微笑和哭泣之间切换得这么快的？这让人极度不安。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall13
: How do you manage to stay so pretty all the time?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么做到一直都这么漂亮的？

lines.en: : Can you teach me, Touka? Can you make me as beautiful as you?
lines.zh: : 你能教我吗，Touka？你能让我变得和你一样美吗？

lines.en: : Well...I suppose I wouldn’t mind showing you my skin care routine...but that still doesn’t really-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我不介意给你看看我的护肤流程……但那还是不太——

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall2
scene yasutoukahall7
scene yasutoukahall5
scene yasutoukahall3
scene yasutoukahall1
scene yasutoukahall9
scene yasutoukahall14
I zone out for a moment due to boredom, but quickly return to my senses as zoning out in front of my students is rude.
lines.zh: 我因为无聊走神了片刻，但很快回过神来——毕竟在学生面前走神是很失礼的。

lines.en: I must pay more attention.
lines.zh: 我必须更加专注。

lines.en: : I suppose all I’m saying is that...I wish you’d be a bit more predictable.
lines.zh: : 我想我要说的只是……我希望你能更可预测一点。

lines.en: : I, too, know what it is like to be thrust into new situations without so much as a warning...
lines.zh: : 我也知道，在毫无预警的情况下被丢进新环境是什么滋味……

lines.en: : But I feel that the manners in which we approach these situations is completely different.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，我们面对这些局面时所采取的方式完全不同。

lines.en: : I try very hard to adapt, while you...
lines.zh: : 我非常努力地去适应，而你……

lines.en: : I rely on the word of God to get me through everything.
lines.zh: : 我依靠神的话语来度过一切。

lines.en: : There is no sense in adapting when we are all but fodder for the one so commonly mislabeled.
lines.zh: : 既然我们都不过是那位常被误称之者的养料，去适应就没有意义。

lines.en: : And, before long, we will find ourselves waist deep in encroaching darkness. And only those with the power of the light will be able to crawl to safety.
lines.zh: : 而且用不了多久，我们就会发现自己深陷于逼近的黑暗之中，齐腰之深。只有拥有光之力量的人，才能爬到安全的地方。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall15
: Crawl with me, Touka! Let us escape the hell that is simply living together as one!
lines.zh: : 和我一起爬吧，Touka！让我们逃离这个“仅仅作为一体共存”的地狱！

lines.en: : Okay, let’s not raise any culty suicide flags so early into your time here.
lines.zh: : 好了，你们才刚来没多久，就别这么早竖起邪教集体自杀的旗子了。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall16
: There is no death. Just a second plane of existence. A plane much greater than this.
lines.zh: : 没有死亡。只是第二层存在。一个远比这一层伟大的存在。

lines.en: : Sensei...I am very scared of this girl.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我很怕这个女孩。

lines.en: : Me too, but you’re just going to have to live with it.
lines.zh: : 我也怕，但你只能忍着。

lines.en: : Are you truly sure that a relationship with {i}her{/i} is beneficial to my academic life as well as my interpersonal one?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定，和{i}她{/i}建立关系对我的学业以及人际关系都有好处吗？

lines.en: : I understand the concept of communicating with more commoners and understanding their thought processes, but Yasu seems to be anything but common.
lines.zh: : 我理解与更多平民交流、理解他们思维过程这个概念，但 Yasu 似乎完全称不上平民。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like this is only going to make things worse for me.
lines.zh: : 我忍不住觉得，这只会让我的处境变得更糟。

lines.en: : And it might. But that’s just how life works.
lines.zh: : 也许会吧。但生活就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Sometimes, you try things out for a little while and find out they don’t really work.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你试着去做一件事，过一阵子发现它并不真的行得通。

lines.en: : Then you move onto whatever is next and try again.
lines.zh: : 然后你转向下一件事，再试一次。

lines.en: : And then everything repeats until you die.
lines.zh: : 于是一切不断重复，直到你死去。

lines.en: : There is no death. Just a second plane of-
lines.zh: : 没有死亡。只是第二层——

lines.en: : We know. Thanks, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我们知道。谢谢，Yasu。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美主。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall17
: Well...I know I told my mother I would listen to you. And I know that you {i}allegedly{/i} have my best interests in mind-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道我跟我母亲说过会听你的。我也知道你{i}据说{/i}是为我着想——

lines.en: : But I would like to implore you to at least closely observe the...dynamic between Yasu and I in the event of the two of us...not getting along very well.
lines.zh: : 但我想恳请你，万一 Yasu 和我相处得不太好，至少密切观察一下我们之间的……相处状态。

lines.en: : Sure thing.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: Not like I wasn’t already planning on closely observing two more adorable girls anyway.
lines.zh: 反正我本来就打算密切观察另外两个可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : In the meantime, why not find out something you two have in common?
lines.zh: : 同时，为什么不找找你们俩的共同点呢？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall18
: That...doesn’t sound like a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来不算是个坏主意。

lines.en: : But...will we be able to find anything?
lines.zh: : 但是……我们真能找到什么吗？

lines.en: : On cold nights, I like to wander the streets in search of the lost or the weary and translate the whispers of the dead for them.
lines.zh: : 在寒冷的夜里，我喜欢在街上游荡，寻找迷途者或疲惫的人，为他们翻译死者们的低语。

lines.en: : What do you like to do with your free time, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你空闲的时候喜欢做什么，Touka？

lines.en: : Um...I like...horses?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我喜欢……马？

lines.en: : Perfect. So take this weekend to go ride horses in the morning and then scare random people on their way home at night.
lines.zh: : 完美。那么这个周末，你们早上就去骑马，晚上再去吓唬回家路上的陌生人。

lines.en: : I’m glad I was able to help you two figure this out.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴能帮你们两个想出这个来。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall19
: Thank you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei！

lines.en: : Wait! We haven’t figured anything out at all!
lines.zh: : 等等！我们什么都没想出来啊！

lines.en: : I don’t know the first thing about the whispers of the dead!
lines.zh: : 我对死者们的低语一无所知！

lines.en: : And how much do you think Yasu knows about horses?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得 Yasu 对马了解多少？

lines.en: : I know that the white horse is a common symbol of “death” and that horse worship can be dated as far back as the bronze age.
lines.zh: : 我知道白马是“死亡”的常见象征，而且对马的崇拜最早可以追溯到青铜时代。

lines.en: : Okay, so maybe Yasu knows a little more about horses than you know about dead people.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许 Yasu 对马的了解，比你对死人的了解要多一点。

lines.en: : But I’d still say you’re on pretty equal footing.
lines.zh: : 但我还是会说，你们的起点大致相当。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall20
: Ugh...If I had known how disadvantageous it would be to live this long without associating with “normal” people, I'd have asked Mother to send me out on my own ages ago.
lines.zh: : 唉……如果我早知道这么长时间不与“正常”人来往会如此吃亏，我早就求母亲让我自己出去闯了。

lines.en: : I can only fear what will become of Tsukasa the moment she finds out the world isn’t as she sees it now.
lines.zh: : 我只能害怕 Tsukasa 一旦发现这个世界并非她现在看到的样子，会变成什么模样。

lines.en: : Nothing you see is as it seems, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你所看到的一切，都不是它看上去的样子，Touka。

lines.en: : Only the chosen can truly discern the paths we walk and the trials and tribulations we will encounter along the way.
lines.zh: : 唯有被选中者，才能真正辨明我们所走的路，以及沿途将要遇到的考验与磨难。

lines.en: : And so I ask that you put your faith in me, and I will put mine in you.
lines.zh: : 所以我请求你把信仰交托给我，而我也会把我的交托给你。

lines.en: : This is the start of something beautiful, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，这是一段美好事物的开始。

lines.en: : A beautiful start here in this beginning of beginnings.
lines.zh: : 一个美好的开始，就在这“开始之开始”中。

lines.en: : The first step on the journey to salvation. A journey I will hold your freshly cleaned hands for.
lines.zh: : 通往救赎之旅的第一步。这段旅程，我会牵着你刚洗干净的手走下去。

lines.en: : Thank you for not talking about the bacteria this time. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这次没提细菌的事。我真的很感激。

lines.en: : I am a good learner. A quick learner.
lines.zh: : 我很会学习。学得很快。

lines.en: : And I hope to learn more and more about you as time ticks slowly toward the day of reckoning.
lines.zh: : 随着时间缓缓流向清算之日，我希望能越来越多地了解你。

lines.en: : Me too?...
lines.zh: : 我也是？……

lines.en: scene yasutoukahall21
: Okay, well I’m gonna go now.
lines.zh: : 好了，那我先走了。

lines.en: : Yasu, please don’t kill Touka. And Touka, please don’t kill Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu，请别杀 Touka。Touka，也请别杀 Yasu。

lines.en: : Even I’d be upset if I lost two new students as soon as I got them.
lines.zh: : 哪怕是我，刚得到两个新学生就失去她们，也会难过的。

lines.en: Especially before seeing either of them without clothes on.
lines.zh: 尤其是在还没看到她们任何一个不穿衣服的样子之前。

lines.en: : I would never harm anyone. It’s {i}my{/i} safety that I fear for.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会伤害任何人。我担心的是{i}我自己{/i}的安全。

lines.en: : And I would never harm anyone either. It goes against everything I believe in.
lines.zh: : 我也绝不会伤害任何人。那违背我所信仰的一切。

lines.en: : It’s settled then.
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了。

lines.en: : Starting right now, you two are friends and must learn to get along with one another.
lines.zh: : 从现在开始，你们两个是朋友了，必须学会彼此好好相处。

lines.en: : And Touka, you are obligated to listen to my every command because your mother said so.
lines.zh: : 还有 Touka，你有义务听从我的每一道命令，因为你母亲是这么说的。

lines.en: : I know, I know...I apologize for my outburst earlier.
lines.zh: : 知道啦，知道啦……我为刚才的失态道歉。

lines.en: : It has just been a very stressful week for me.
lines.zh: : 这一周对我来说压力实在很大。

lines.en: : Thank you for taking the time to remind us of how deeply you care for our well-being, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 感谢您抽出时间提醒我们，您有多么在乎我们的幸福，Sensei。

lines.en: : May the path you walk be free of callousness.
lines.zh: : 愿您所行之路远离冷漠。

lines.en: : And...yours too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……也愿你如此吧，大概。

lines.en: scene black
I turn around and leave the two of them, not being immediately stopped this time.
lines.zh: 我转身离开她们两个，这次没有被立刻拦下。

lines.en: To be quite honest, I doubt their relationship will work out at all.
lines.zh: 说实话，我怀疑她们的关系根本不会有结果。

lines.en: They’re far too different and...far too eccentric to ever work in tandem with one another.
lines.zh: 她们太过不同，而且……都太过古怪，永远无法真正协调一致。

lines.en: All I can hope is that they don’t drive each other insane.
lines.zh: 我唯一能希望的，就是她们别把对方逼疯。

lines.en: Well, all I can hope is that Yasu doesn’t drive Touka insane, I guess.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想我唯一能希望的，是 Yasu 别把 Touka 逼疯。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure Yasu is a lost cause already.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Yasu 已经是个没救的人了。

lines.en: Regardless, there’s no telling how things will play out without the passage of time.
lines.zh: 无论如何，不经过时间的流逝，谁也说不清事情会如何发展。

lines.en: And what better way to pass the time than to leave work and aimlessly wander around Kumon-mi for what is likely the millionth, billionth, or trillionth time?...
lines.zh: 而还有什么比下班后在 Kumon-mi 漫无目的地闲逛——大概是第一百万、第十亿、第一万亿次——更能打发时间的呢？……
